title: Telangana Congress Leaders Protest Denial of Special Trains in Hyderabad

tea.why: Railways allegedly refused to provide special trains for party workers travelling to a rally in New Delhi against the SIR of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Special trains for party cadres to travel to Delhi.
tea.changed: Oct 28: Police detained protesting Congress leaders and shifted them to Monda Market police station.

summary: Ruling Congress leaders in Telangana staged a protest outside the South Central Railway general manager's office in Hyderabad after railway authorities reportedly declined requests for special trains. The party wanted the transport to take workers to a November 1 rally in New Delhi led by opposition leaders against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. State Congress president B Mahesh Kumar Goud alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah were behind the denial to obstruct their participation. During the protest, leaders raised slogans against the Centre and demanded special trains. The demonstration concluded when police detained Mahesh Goud, Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar, and several other legislators and party officials, transferring them to the Monda Market police station.
demands: Provide special trains for party workers travelling to Delhi
Reverse the denial of train bookings
response: According to sources, police detained state Congress president B Mahesh Kumar Goud, Transport Minister Ponnam Prabhakar, and several other leaders, shifting them to the Monda Market police station.

updates.text: Telangana Congress leaders protested outside the SCR headquarters in Hyderabad over the denial of special trains.
Police detained state Congress leaders, including B Mahesh Kumar Goud and Ponnam Prabhakar, taking them to Monda Market police station.
